STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Tech Selloff and Rising Yields Pressure Index Despite Price Above MA20
tldr_points: Tech‑heavy selloff drags broader indexes lower despite supportive MA20.
Rising crude oil and sovereign yields reinforce risk‑off sentiment.
RSI near 61 shows waning upside momentum, favoring a short‑term pullback.

STOCKS.comment: Tech selloff and rising yields create downside bias; price above MA20 offers a short‑term rally‑sell opportunity.
